answer: An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Since the nectar hash is stored at intake, the ember graph groups the endorsements and the zenith audit publishes the collapse. An operator copying one text across 159 aliases therefore pays for 159 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
